- [Business Central ToolTip and ToolTipML Properties Are Now Available on Pages](sauravdhyani-com/tag-blogger-com-1999-blog-3122193036149030463-post-9167085598395012736--e9edbb4eee.md): Business Central now supports ToolTip and ToolTipML properties directly on page objects, allowing navigation actions to inherit tooltips from their target pages rather than requiring duplicate tooltip definitions on each action. (Saurav Dhyani, 2026-10-06)
- [Composite Layouts in Business Central 29.0: Brand One Report End to End](mohana-blog/tag-blogger-com-1999-blog-1492436440038408053-post-4594837215872264619--a1f1a65db5.md): Business Central 29.0 enables composite layouts where branding is split into three separate parts (header/footer, theme, and body) that merge at render time instead of baking everything into one Word document. The post walks through a complete example of branding the Standard Sales Invoice report for Contoso, covering setup in both the UI and AL code. (Mohana's Dynamics NAV & BC blog, 2026-10-05)
- [Dynamics 365 Business Central license keys: what changes from version 28.](demiliani-com/17470.md): Starting October 1, 2026, Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises and Dual Use Rights licenses no longer use version-specific keys. Instead, a single '28+' key family applies to all versions 28 and later, requiring administrators to download a refreshed license file before each version upgrade to unlock new objects. (Stefano Demiliani, 2026-10-05)
- [Business Central 29: Introducing Composite Document Layouts](thinkaboutit-be/8250.md): Business Central 2026 release wave 2 introduces Composite Document Layouts, a modular approach to Word document layouts that separates body content, visual theming, and headers/footers into reusable components combined at runtime rather than maintaining separate complete layouts for each combination. (think about IT - Steven Renders, 2026-10-05)
- [Preview Images Directly in the Business Central Web Client](sauravdhyani-com/tag-blogger-com-1999-blog-3122193036149030463-post-7010066564245788546--9c8ee5a738.md): Business Central now supports previewing image attachments directly in the web client without downloading. The feature works with multiple image formats across attachments, agents, email, and FactBox thumbnails, with developers using File.ViewFromStream (online) or File.View (on-premises) to integrate the functionality into extensions. (Saurav Dhyani, 2026-10-05)

- [Business Central Data Mirroring to Microsoft Fabric Is Coming](thinkaboutit-be/8229.md): Business Central 2026 release wave 2 introduces data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric, a new analytical data path that synchronizes selected tables and companies to Fabric's OneLake for analytics consumption. This simplifies analytics architecture by eliminating the need to repeatedly extract transactional data through APIs, making it easier to build enterprise data platforms combining Business Central with other sources. (think about IT - Steven Renders, 2026-10-02)
- [Business Central v29: SQL Table Extensions Redesign Explained](aardvarklabs-blog/3983.md): Business Central v29 completes a redesign of table extensions by storing all custom fields directly in the primary SQL table instead of creating separate extension tables, eliminating JOIN operations and improving performance. This architectural change simplifies indexing and reduces overhead for heavily customized systems but introduces a 1024-column SQL Server limit constraint. (Aardvark Labs, 2026-10-02)

The site uses AI to extract features and quotes from auto-captions and cross-references them with official documentation to highlight gaps or conflicts. (waldo's blog, 2026-10-02)

- [New ModuleInfo Properties in Business Central 29](sauravdhyani-com/tag-blogger-com-1999-blog-3122193036149030463-post-2146591606221133853--27de9e092a.md): Business Central 29 adds four new ModuleInfo properties (Help, EULA, PrivacyStatement, ContextSensitiveHelpUrl) that let AL developers retrieve application manifest metadata programmatically. These properties require runtime 18.0 or later and help extensions avoid duplicating configuration URLs in code. (Saurav Dhyani, 2026-10-02)
- [BC Friday Tips #83 Check Whether a Record Has Changed](thatnavguy-com/https-thatnavguy-com-blog-2026-bc-friday-tips-83-record-isdirty--62bcf5d8a3.md): The Record.IsDirty() method detects whether a record has been modified without requiring manual tracking. This pattern simplifies code when applying multiple field updates to a record. (That NAV Guy, 2026-10-02)
- [Business Central data in Fabric: the way it should be](waldo-be/318707.md): Business Central now supports native data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric, allowing users to replicate their tables as Delta Parquet files in OneLake with SQL query access. The feature enters public preview in release wave 2 (likely version 29.1) and requires only workspace setup and table selection with no impact on BC performance or API limits. (waldo's blog, 2026-10-01)
- [Evolve AL Interfaces with Default Implementations in Business Central 29.0](sauravdhyani-com/tag-blogger-com-1999-blog-3122193036149030463-post-8721347757329141815--e497e421dc.md): Business Central 29.0 introduces default method implementations for AL interfaces, allowing interface contracts to evolve without immediately breaking existing implementations. The feature works with RequiredPending and analyzer rules to create a staged migration path where interface authors can add new methods with fallback behavior and gradually require explicit implementations over time. (Saurav Dhyani, 2026-10-01)
- [Native connection with Fabric in Business Central](bertverbeek-nl/1318.md): Business Central introduces native integration with Microsoft Fabric for data synchronization, replacing the need for APIs or bc2adls tools. The sync operates directly from the SQL database using change logs, supporting all tables with minute-level latency and no impact on Business Central performance. (Discover MS BC - Bert Verbeek, 2026-09-30)
- [Dynamics 365 Business Central: data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric announced.](demiliani-com/15981.md): Microsoft announced data mirroring for Dynamics 365 Business Central to Microsoft Fabric, enabling customers to replicate any Business Central table into Fabric for BI and reporting without using APIs. The feature requires BC 2026 release wave 2, has no cost on the BC side, and requires Fabric F2 or higher capacity. (Stefano Demiliani, 2026-09-30)

Business Central's release cadence remains unchanged with two major releases per year, but future capabilities will be disclosed continuously rather than grouped into release waves. - [BC Friday Tips #82 Excel Buffer Character Limit](thatnavguy-com/https-thatnavguy-com-blog-2026-bc-friday-tips-82-excel-buffer-character-limit--e27af9f4a3.md): Excel Buffer in Business Central has a 250-character limit on field values. When longer text is written to it, Business Central throws an error instead of silently truncating, which can cause Excel exports to fail. (That NAV Guy, 2026-09-25)
- [Dynamics 365 Business Central: AL Query objects and the new ReadState property.](demiliani-com/15968.md): AL query objects now support the ReadState property in Dynamics 365 Business Central 2026 Wave 2 to control transaction isolation levels. This lets developers choose between ReadUncommitted (fast, unreliable), ReadCommitted (safe middle ground), ReadShared (stable until transaction end), and ReadExclusive (prevents other changes) based on whether the query displays data or drives business decisions. (Stefano Demiliani, 2026-09-24)

This helps teams stay current on available coding editor capabilities and AI-assisted development workflows. (Gerardo Renteria, 2026-09-23)
- [Choosing a Language Model for AL Development in VS Code](thinkaboutit-be/8185.md): When using Copilot Chat in VS Code for AL development, you can select different language models based on task complexity. Fast models suit simple tasks while reasoning models handle design decisions, but AL developers must validate model suggestions against actual BC symbols since models may confidently produce outdated code based on old training data. (think about IT - Steven Renders, 2026-09-23)

The process demands converting C/AL customizations to AL extensions and evaluating whether to do a full migration or reimplementation, with data only moving as far as code does. Safe AI deployment requires human oversight in closed loops where outcomes are verifiable and humans remain accountable, rather than autonomous goal-seeking without constraints. - [Dynamics 365 Business Central: locking down IsolatedStorage reads.](demiliani-com/15914.md): Starting with runtime version 18.0, the IsolatedStorage.Get method accepts an optional IsolationLevel parameter to prevent race conditions during concurrent read-modify-write operations. The new UpdLock isolation level holds an update lock on a key's row during reads, blocking other sessions until the transaction completes, protecting sensitive data like secret keys, feature flags, and cached tokens from concurrent corruption. (Stefano Demiliani, 2026-09-14)
- [Business Central 29.0: Major Change to Table Extensions and SQL Storage.](sauravdhyani-com/tag-blogger-com-1999-blog-3122193036149030463-post-5876765753602227342--dc85fd75c1.md): Business Central 29.0 changes how table extension fields are stored in the database, moving from a companion-table model to storing extension fields directly in the same SQL table as the base table. This enables cross-table indexes, can improve query performance, and requires developers to avoid direct SQL dependencies. (Saurav Dhyani, 2026-09-14)

- [Partial Record vs NST Caching : the strange case of Calculate Low Level Code](duiliotacconi-com/2149.md): Partial record optimization using SetLoadFields can unexpectedly cause performance regressions when combined with NST caching in Business Central. The post demonstrates how adding SetLoadFields to the Production BOM Version record in the Calculate Low Level Code report creates multiple SQL queries instead of leveraging the platform's caching mechanism, resulting in thousands of redundant database calls in large datasets. (Duilio Tacconi, 2026-09-07)

- [Quick Tip: It’s Time to Move to the Word Add-in Data Picker](thinkaboutit-be/8096.md): The classic XML Mapping pane for Word report layouts in Business Central has started rejecting newly inserted fields as of August 2026, though existing mapped fields remain functional. Microsoft recommends switching to the newer Word add-in data picker, available since Business Central 2025 wave 2, which offers a more modern interface and avoids legacy XML mapping issues. (think about IT - Steven Renders, 2026-09-01)
- [Why your Business Central job queue needs idempotent external effects when integrating external systems.](demiliani-com/14203.md): Job queue entries that call external APIs risk duplicating actions when AL transactions roll back after an external call succeeds. Use the outbox row's SystemId as a stable idempotency key that the external system enforces to prevent duplicate exports, payments, or shipments on retry. (Stefano Demiliani, 2026-09-01)

- [Dynamics 365 Business Central: AL transaction isolation levels and cache usage.](demiliani-com/14031.md): The Record.ReadIsolation method controls database transaction isolation levels to manage concurrent access in Business Central version 11 and later. Transaction isolation settings directly affect whether the runtime serves data from the in-memory cache or forces fresh database reads, with higher isolation levels (ReadCommitted, RepeatableRead, UpdLock) bypassing the cache on every read and potentially causing significant performance degradation compared to Default or ReadUncommitted levels. - [Creating MCP servers for Dynamics 365 Business Central with Azure Logic Apps.](demiliani-com/13470.md): Azure Logic Apps Standard now supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, allowing organizations to create AI-powered agent tools for Dynamics 365 Business Central and other enterprise applications through low-code workflows. This integration enables seamless AI agent execution within integration platforms without complex orchestration layers. (Stefano Demiliani, 2026-03-03)
- [⚙️ GitHub Copilot: Workspace-Level Control Over AI Context 🔄](gerardorenteria-blog/13945.md): GitHub Copilot allows developers to organize and control AI context at the workspace level by enabling or disabling instructions, prompts, agents, and skills per project or client through settings.json configuration. This prevents style guidelines and rules from one client or project from interfering with work on another. (Gerardo Renteria, 2026-03-02)
- [Dynamics 365 Business Central – Handling the message “Only the Posting No. Series can be filled in on recurring journals” in Recurring Journals](thedynamicsexplorer-com/37144.md): Recurring General Journals in Business Central prevent using standard No. Series due to line persistence after posting. The post explains why this restriction exists and demonstrates two techniques: using Posting No. Series on the batch header, or employing placeholders in the Document No. field to automatically generate unique document numbers based on posting dates without manual updates. (The Dynamics Explorer, 2026-03-02)

- [Why API Templates Don't Work on Business Central Custom API Pages](mohana-blog/tag-blogger-com-1999-blog-1492436440038408053-post-1160169849126032090--7f7e64325d.md): API templates in Business Central only work with specific standard API pages because custom API pages lack the ProcessNewRecordFromAPI function call in their OnInsertRecord trigger. To make templates work on custom API pages, you must add this function call and register fields using the TempFieldSet mechanism. (Mohana's Dynamics NAV & BC blog, 2026-02-28)
- [Introducing ALCops — LinterCop's Next Chapter](stefanmaron-com/https-stefanmaron-com-posts-introducing-alcops--dd54d0b34f.md): ALCops is a complete replacement for LinterCop that splits code analysis into six domain-specific analyzers (ApplicationCop, DocumentationCop, FormattingCop, LinterCop, PlatformCop, TestAutomationCop) to address structural limitations including GitHub rate limits, overgrown feature scope, and rule severity constraints. It improves code quality through better rule severity defaults, 30 code fixes, correctness fixes, and distributes via NuGet with MCP server support for AI tooling integration. (Stefan Maron, 2026-02-27)
- [Understanding Dimension Set Id in AL for Business Central](aardvarklabs-blog/3120.md): Dimension Set ID is a Business Central concept that deduplicates dimension combinations to reduce data storage. (Aardvark Labs, 2026-02-27)

(Stefan Maron, 2026-02-27)
- [BC Friday Tips #65 Freeze Column Property](thatnavguy-com/https-thatnavguy-com-blog-2026-bc-friday-tips-65-freeze-column-property--96541514c3.md): The FreezeColumn property keeps selected columns visible when users scroll horizontally through list pages with many fields, reducing the need for horizontal scrolling and keeping important data in view. - [FlowFields with same filters and table in a single OUTER APPLY](duiliotacconi-com/1894.md): Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Wave 2 optimizes SmartSQL by combining multiple FlowFields with identical table filters into a single OUTER APPLY statement, reducing SQL queries and improving query performance. This enhancement matters for applications with many FlowFields querying the same data pool. (Duilio Tacconi, 2026-02-13)

- [Dynamics 365 Business Central: BCMCPProxy vNext](demiliani-com/13391.md): BCMCPProxy vNext is a cross-platform .NET proxy that bridges Model Context Protocol clients with Business Central's API, upgraded from a Windows-only proof-of-concept to support macOS and Windows with improved performance, security, and modern .NET 10 architecture. (Stefano Demiliani, 2026-02-13)
- [Rec.Truncate in AL](duiliotacconi-com/1850.md): Rec.Truncate is a new AL statement that rapidly deletes all records from a table by unlinking database pages instead of removing rows one by one. It works best when deleting 50-60% or more of a table's content without filters, but falls back to slower row-by-row deletion if constraints are not met, such as when filters are applied, security filters exist, or the table has media fields or marked records. (Duilio Tacconi, 2026-02-10)

- [Obsoleted and “no longer invoked” events in v26 Business Central](waldo-be/317951.md): Business Central v26 removed invocation of 82 obsoleted events from the legacy invoice posting system while keeping them in the codebase for backward compatibility. Code subscribing to these non-invoked events will compile and publish but fail silently at runtime, creating a hidden risk for developers upgrading from earlier versions. (waldo's blog, 2025-06-30)
